Class PreComputePhase

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.PreComputePhase
public class PreComputePhase extends Object
Pre-computation phase that runs BEFORE simulation ticks begin.

Responsibilities:

  1. Register canonical historical geophysical disasters
  2. Compute initial paleoclimate and glaciological forcings
  3. Initialize biophysical resource stockpiles via Miami NPP (Lieth 1975)
  4. Distribute initial human population (empirical HYDE/WorldPop dasymetric downscaling for Earth)
  5. Seed initial physical capital ($K_0$), metal, technology, friction, and demographic cohorts

Strictly compliant with Ether Determinism Directives (AGENTS.md Â§3 & Â§8): empirical data sources are preserved as authoritative invariants, and procedural derivations employ closed-form physical equations with zero pseudo-random noise.

      public static double calculateHerbaceousPastureCarryingCapacity(double temp, double rain, double elev, double areaScale)
      Calculates herbaceous pasture carrying capacity for wild grazing herbivores (McNaughton 1985; Sala et al. 1988).
      Parameters:

      rain - precipitation in $\text{mm}$
      elev - elevation in meters

      Returns:
